description: This file defines the SubfinderOutputProcessor class, which processes JSON output files from the Subfinder tool to extract host assets and produce a ProcessorResult.

classes.name: SubfinderOutputProcessor
classes.description: A class extending AbstractOutputProcessor that processes Subfinder JSON output files to extract host assets and generate processing results.

methods.name: getCommandUsageExample
methods.description: Returns an example command line usage for the Subfinder tool.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Reads a JSON file line-by-line, decodes each JSON object, extracts the 'host' field, and adds it as an Asset to the ProcessorResult.
